ambiguities.source_text: Round both the monthly budget and monthly Actual Spending to the nearest whole number using round half to even
ambiguities.intent: Round the monthly budget and monthly actual spending separately to nearest integers, using half-to-even at exact midpoints; then Difference = rounded Actual Spending - rounded Budget. This rounding rule is now explicit in query.

ambiguities.source_text: Exclude any area that is below budget at an annual level
ambiguities.intent: Exclude only categories whose annual actual spending is below their annual budget. Retain categories exactly at budget as well as those above budget, using AnnualActual >= AnnualBudget.
When comparing annual actual vs budget, restrict to categories that exist in the budget table (drop actual-only categories).

ambiguities.source_text: If multiple categories tie for the highest overspending in a month, output only the first one in the combined input processing order (monthly-file processing order, then category order within each month).
ambiguities.intent: For a monthly tie in maximum Difference, select exactly one category: the first in combined input processing order, based on monthly-file processing order and category order within each month. This selection rule is explicit in query and does not prescribe final output row ordering.
